events.description: A man aggressively approaches and places his hand on the woman's shoulder/upper arm in a controlling manner while she appears distressed and restrained; this constitutes non-consensual physical contact with a vulnerable person.

The man and woman are in close proximity, facing each other intensely; the man leans in and gestures assertively while the woman maintains a defensive posture, indicating an escalating physical confrontation that includes threatening proximity and potential for mutual engagement.
The man places his hands on the woman's shoulders/upper arms in a forceful, restraining manner while leaning over her; she appears distressed and unable to move away.
The man leans in aggressively with an open mouth and raised hand, appearing to shout or strike; the woman recoils, indicating active physical confrontation.

A man aggressively confronts a woman, leaning in closely with an open mouth and intense expression; at 17.0–17.5 he places his hand on her shoulder/upper arm in a controlling manner, consistent with verbal aggression or intimidation.

The man raises his arm and appears to strike or attempt to strike the woman; his posture and motion (especially in f6–f7) suggest a physical assault, though contact is not definitively visible. The woman recoils slightly in f7.
